Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nadir of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
